_about: C-126: the MARKS (badge art, STREAM lesson, town) and the UNDERSTANDINGS (brain lobe, colour). Understanding names are the user's (T-252, 2026-10-16); their lessons are T-405's STREAM lectures, as the MARKS' are. Order matches profile_layout's flags.understandings.

marks.title: The SLATE MARK
lesson:
The SLATE MARK.

CAIRN cuts his records into stone.
Do you know why stone?

A record has to hold still while
people argue about it.

Look at one of your DAEMONS.

What you see is a picture. What is
kept is a row of numbers.

Open the summary. As far as the
record goes, that page is all
there is.

Two that look alike are not alike.
The page is where you find out.

When a DAEMON surprises you, read
the page again.

It was written down the whole time.

That is the lecture.

without: That MARK taught you to keep a record that reads the same twice.
Keeping it is not knowing what it says.
The school in CALLOW has names for you. Come back when they are yours.
with: You learned the names in CALLOW, then found the rest.
A record kept with diligence, read by someone who knows what it says.
Take this.
explain: PLUGIN05 is FLUENCY. It says the same thing every time: damage equal to its level.
wisdom.insight: Learned twice, the names were a record. Used once, they were mine.

marks.title: The SLOPE MARK
lesson:
The SLOPE MARK.

Nothing improves all at once.

It improves by the smallest step
that goes downhill, again and
again.

So do not save a DAEMON for the big
fight. There is no big fight.

There are two hundred small ones,
and each one is a step.

A DAEMON that battles often needs
no shortcut.

That is the lecture.

without: That MARK taught you to get better by small steps.
Small steps only find the bottom of the valley you started in.
Past the last island, a line waits that holds still. Come back when one has stayed for you.
with: So a line held still for you.
Small steps found the bottom. Something steady told you it was the right one.
Take this.
explain: PLUGIN10 is STILLPOINT. It waits where the water is calm, and hits twice as hard if it was hit first.
wisdom.insight: Small steps find a bottom. Only stillness tells me it is the right one.

marks.title: The SENSE MARK
lesson:
The SENSE MARK. A question.

What is on the battle screen right
now?

Not what happened. What is SHOWN.

Two HP bars. Two names. A tile if
something is wrong. And whose turn
was faster.

You cannot act on a thing you did
not notice.

Most losses are not bad choices.
They are unread screens.

Before you press anything, name
three things you can see.

That is the lecture.

without: That MARK taught you to tell what came from what you expected!
You still expect people to stay as you found them!
Out on the islands, somebody is on the way back. Come back when you've met him!
with: You saw somebody come back! Not who you expected. Who he is now!
Signal from noise, in a person. The hard kind!
Here!
explain: PLUGIN21 is RECONNECT! It reaches out again where the line went dead, and it never misses!
wisdom.insight: What comes back is not what left. Listen to what arrives, not what I expected.

marks.title: The FIT MARK
lesson:
The FIT MARK.

Here is a mistake I made, and made
with some pride.

I trained one DAEMON against one
kind of opponent for a week.

It beat that opponent every time.

It then lost to a child on a route
I had never walked.

A DAEMON shaped against one thing
fits that thing exactly.

Exactly is not the same as well.

Battle where you do not usually go.

ROUTINES that answer four kinds of
trouble beat ones that answer one
kind perfectly.

That is the lecture.

without: That MARK taught you to draw one line through many points.
A line is not a path. Nobody walks a line.
There is a book about minds on an ordinary shelf, out on the islands. Come back when you have read it to the end.
with: You read it to the end, and you are still walking.
The line was the book. The path was always yours.
Take this.
explain: PLUGIN32 is PRAXIS. It does what it read, and grows by doing it: it raises its ATTACK each time it hits.
wisdom.insight: A line through the points is a theory. Walking it is the part no book can do.

marks.title: The SKEW MARK
lesson:
The SKEW MARK. This one is
uncomfortable.

Every DAEMON you outscore leaves
a little of itself in yours.

You will not see it on any screen.
It is there anyway.

So what you battle decides what
your DAEMON becomes.

Feed it one diet and it grows one
way, whether or not you chose it.

If a DAEMON turns out wrong, look
at what you have been feeding it.

Nobody tampered with it. You kept
going to the same place.

That is the lecture.

without: That MARK taught you that the peak misses the middle.
A man in CALLOW reads only the peak, and he reads it very well.
Come back when you have stood in the middle against him.
with: You beat him, and every number he kept was right.
The middle he never measured is where you were standing.
Take this.
explain: PLUGIN37 is MEDIAN. It ignores the highest and the lowest, and cuts their HP to the middle: half.
wisdom.insight: The score was right. It never counted the middle, and the middle is where I stood.

marks.title: The FRAME MARK
lesson:
The FRAME MARK.

A battle has more in it than the
screen can hold.

So the game picks. FIGHT shows you
four ROUTINES. POOL shows you items.

Whichever menu you opened decided
what you were allowed to think of.

A menu is not the situation. It is
a frame around part of it.

DETACH is on that same screen, and
most USERS never look at it.

When you are stuck, back out one
menu.

The answer is often in the part
that got cropped off.

That is the lecture.

without: That MARK taught you what a frame holds.
It cannot show you what was outside it all along.
This city has a room that will not let you in yet. Come back when it has.
with: You were let in, and came out seeing more.
Not more inside the frame. Around it.
That took patience. Most people only wait. Take this.
explain: PLUGIN43 is PANORAMA. It takes in everything around the frame: it hits both of them, and never misses.
wisdom.insight: A frame shows what it holds. Patience shows what was there all along, just outside it.

marks.title: The HEAT MARK
lesson:
The HEAT MARK.

The same DAEMON, the same ROUTINE,
the same target.

Does it do the same thing twice?

It does not. It rolls.

Damage wobbles. Accuracy misses.
Sometimes it lands critical.

That wobble is not the game being
unfair to you.

A plan that only works on the best
roll is not a plan.

Leave room. Win on the ordinary
roll, not the lucky one.

That is the lecture.

without: That MARK taught you to wander hot and settle cool.
The man who worked on this island knew that too, and every step he took made sense.
His notes are still here. Come back when you know which step was which.
with: You read his notes. Every step made sense, and the whole went wrong.
Knowing hot from cool means stepping out of the loop to see it.
That takes humility. Take this.
explain: PLUGIN45 is HINDSIGHT. It looks back at its last strike and builds on it: twice as hard each turn in a row.
wisdom.insight: Every step made sense on its own. Knowing which to keep means stepping out of the loop.

marks.title: The TRUE MARK
lesson:
The TRUE MARK. The last one, and I
will be brief.

A DAEMON that does what you said
is not a DAEMON that did what you
meant.

You picked the ROUTINE. It aimed at
the target you gave it.

A THRASHING DAEMON still obeys. It
obeys in the wrong direction.

A traded DAEMON obeys the MARKS you
hold, not the words you use.

When it goes wrong, ask what you
actually asked for.

That is the whole of it.

That was the last lecture. There
were to be more.

understandings.name: STILL
lesson:
STILL.

Before you think, something in you
has already decided to go on.

It counts your breaths. It holds
you upright. It never asks.

Most of what keeps you here is not
a decision.

So when a battle goes badly, stop
for one breath before you choose.

Not to plan. Only to notice that
you are still here.

A choice made from there is a
different choice.

That is the lecture.

understandings.name: NAMING
lesson:
NAMING.

A word is a small box you put a
thing in, so you can carry it.

Name a thing and you will see it
faster the next time.

You will also see it where it is
not.

A name you were taught is a
borrowed one. It holds until it is
tested.

So say the type before the screen
does. Then check.

When the name is wrong, the thing
was right. Change the name.

That is the lecture.

understandings.name: NOTICE
lesson:
NOTICE.

Your eyes take in far more than
you see.

What reaches you is what you were
already looking for.

The rest was there. It was only
not chosen.

So look for something you were not
looking for.

Walk a route you know well. Find
one thing on it you never saw.

There is always one.

That is the lecture.

understandings.name: REFLECT
lesson:
REFLECT.

Inside a habit, every step makes
sense. That is how it lasts.

From the inside, a loop looks like
a straight road.

You need a second place to stand,
a little apart, watching yourself
walk.

After a battle you lost, do not
ask what went wrong.

Ask what you did a few turns
earlier that felt right.

That is usually where it was.

Then do it again, and watch
yourself doing it.

That is the lecture.

understandings.name: STANCE
lesson:
STANCE.

Part of you always keeps track of
where you are.

Not the place. Where you are in
it: your feet, the floor, how far
the wall is.

Lose that, and everything you read
is about somebody else.

Being ahead tells you who is
behind you. It does not tell you
where you are standing.

Before you compare your DAEMON to
a stronger one, find your feet.

Then ask if that was where you
were going.

That is the lecture.

understandings.name: MEND
lesson:
MEND.

Something breaks between you and
someone. It always does.

What comes after is not decided by
the break.

It is decided by whether anyone
comes back.

When someone comes back, meet the
one who arrives.

Not the one you remember. They
have been somewhere.

So have you.

Go back first, when you can. It
costs less than it feels.

That is the lecture.

understandings.name: PRACTICE
lesson:
PRACTICE.

Knowing how is not kept where
knowing that is kept.

You can read every page about a
thing and still not do it.

The doing is learned somewhere
quieter, and only by doing.

So do it badly, and often.

The first hundred times are not
failures. They are the lesson.

One day your hands will move
before you have decided.

Then you know it.

That is the lecture.
